court_cases: Multiple active Indian court proceedings, company as PETITIONER (not defendant) in all identified matters. (1) Bombay High Court, WP No.1242/2021, 'VJ Jindal Cocoa Private Limited vs National E-Assessment Centre (NeAC)', order 08.02.2022, bench K.R. Shriram / N.J. Jamadar — income-tax e-assessment challenge. (2) Bombay High Court, WP(L) No.6473/2023, 'Jindal Cocoa LLP & Ors vs Reserve Bank of India & Ors', order 15.03.2023, bench G.S. Patel / Neela Gokhale. (3) Bombay High Court, 'Jindal Cocoa LLP vs Reserve Bank of India', order 03.01.2025, bench B.P. Colabawalla — petitioners Jindal Cocoa LLP, Vijay Jindal, Jayshree Vijay Jindal vs RBI, Union of India, Banking Ombudsman; judgment describes the LLP as 'Borrower' engaged in exporting cocoa. (4) Supreme Court of India, Diary No.22064/2025, 'Jindal Cocoa LLP & Ors vs Reserve Bank of India & Ors' — SLP arising from the Bombay HC order; listed 16.07.2025, 31.10.2025, 09.12.2025, 15.01.2026 and 02.02.2026 (bench P.S. Narasimha). (5) Jammu & Kashmir / Ladakh HC line of cases involving the affiliated entity VJ Jindal Cocoa Pvt Ltd (formerly Jindal Drugs Pvt Ltd, Cocoa Division) vs Union of India — orders 27.05.2021, 26.05.2023, 11.09.2023, 14.02.2023 and 02.02.2026 (JKLHC-JMU:169-DB) — largely excise/tax and SIDCO/land matters. Status: all appear to be writ/SLP proceedings initiated by the company against tax and banking authorities; no judgment located showing the company as a defendant, and no criminal case located. Sources: indiankanoon.org search results for 'Jindal Cocoa' (386 hits) and '"Jindal Cocoa LLP" Reserve Bank of India 2025' (7 hits).
news_risk: No negative news (fraud, probe, enforcement) located. The web_search tool was non-functional throughout this session (searx connection refused) and Bing/DuckDuckGo fallbacks returned irrelevant or timed out, so open-web news coverage could NOT be screened — this is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. The only substantive risk signal is the litigation record itself: a borrower-vs-RBI dispute running from Bombay HC (2023, 2025) up to the Supreme Court (2025-2026), which indicates a live banking/credit dispute with the lender's regulator. Per project rules this is noted neutrally as 'есть сложности' and is not a rejection ground.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. No customs, B-L or contract record located. The company's own website (jindalcocoa.com) markets cocoa products domestically in India (retail e-commerce, corporate gifting) and describes an export business, but no destination list is published and no Russia/CIS shipment was identified. Status: not confirmed either way — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
